description: Get the food menu for a specific restaurant on this site. Returns menus with their sections, dishes, descriptions, prices, and dietary labels (vegan, gluten-free, etc). Use search_places or list_categories first to find the restaurant's place_slug.

place_slug.description: The slug of the restaurant, e.g. "bar-do-ze" (from search_places or a place URL).

name: get_restaurant_menus
